class.name: SteamScoreUpload
class.brief_description: The receipt Steam returned for an accepted score submission.

method.name: get_changed
method.description: Whether the submission became the current leaderboard score. Keep-best can accept the submission while retaining the old score.

method.name: get_previous_rank
method.description: The player's rank before submission. Zero means the player had no previous entry.

method.name: get_rank
method.description: The player's global rank after Steam evaluated the submission.

method.name: get_score
method.description: The signed 32-bit score submitted to Steam.
